Overview

Montana is a city in Montana with a population of 42,000. A city in northwestern Bulgaria, known for its Roman remains, the Montana Art Gallery, and the nearby Ogosta Reservoir recreation area. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
